name: 2x RX 7900 XTX llama.cpp ROCm 7.1.1: Llama 3.1 70B Q4_K_M FA-on tg128
unit: tok/s (tg128, per-request, batch 1, split across 2 GPUs)
methodology: Same box and build as the 7B rows: llama.cpp 34ce48d97, ROCm 7.1.1, llama-bench ngl 99, fa 1, test tg128. The model is 39.59 GiB, so it is split across both 24 GB cards; there is no GPU-to-GPU link beyond the host PCIe Gen4 bus. Reported 13.37 +/- 0.01. Per-request batch-1 decode of the split model, not an aggregate of two independent requests. The no-FA cell of the same run was 13.06 +/- 0.01.
notes: pp512 on the same dual-GPU run was 341.41 +/- 0.23 with FA on and 330.06 +/- 0.38 with FA off. The repo's own 7B dual-GPU test was slower than one card (tg128 94.13 against 118 to 130), so the split only pays for models that do not fit in 24 GB.
